arStrings.szText:
Casting a Non-{c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill has a {c_number}[SF_1 * 100|%1|]{/c} chance to invoke the Spirits of that Skill's types which deal {c_random}[SF_2 * 100|%|]{/c} increased damage. 

This chance is increased by {c_number}[SF_3 * 100|%+|]{/c} of your {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill Damage, up to {c_number}[SF_4 * 100|%|]{/c}.

Your {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skills benefit from all of their Upgrades.
Earn by defeating Bartuc within the Infernal Hordes in Torment I or higher.
